ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in rectangle $ABCD$, $AC$ intersects $BD$ at point $O$. If $\angle COB=120^\circ$ and $AB=6$, what is the length of the diagonal $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rectangle,\\
$ \therefore BD = 2OB$, $AC = 2OA$, $AC = BD$,\\
$ \therefore OA = OB$,\\
Since $\angle BOC = 120^\circ$,\\
$ \therefore \angle AOB = 60^\circ$,\\
$ \therefore \triangle AOB$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
$ \therefore OB = AB = 6$,\\
$ \therefore BD = 2OB = \boxed{12}$.
